claim: every response is application/json; charset=utf-8
POST answers 201, status open, priority defaults to normal
ids are T- and four digits, in order
a ticket has exactly id,title,priority,requester,status,created,updated
times are ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds
filters combine (AND): ?status=open&priority=urgent lists only open urgent tickets
a filter value that is not a status is 400 invalid in the envelope
observed: 400 {"error":{"code":"invalid","message":"status must be one of open, in_progress, resolved, closed"}}

claim: audit is oldest first with increasing seq
creating notifies the requester (ticket.created sent)
(operations) resolved, reopened and resolved again within seconds sends one resolved notification
NOTIFY_FILE gets one JSON line per sent notification
limit defaults to 20 and next is a cursor
